takes.name: Hammer: step in 3 blocks and backhand through
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; construct block hammer; mob stands 3 blocks past normal reach; you step 3 blocks in on the wind-up (camera moves with you); hit tick 11; swing 17 ticks, played once; the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact; forms: pixel jet, tip first (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Dash combo: cross, cross, prime high, dash thrust
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; cross, cross, 0.7 s charge (14 ticks) with the sword primed upward 20 deg above pointing at the mob, then a ~12-block dash; camera travels with you; hit tick 37; swing 46 ticks, played once; charge before the swing (ticks 18-32); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact; forms: pixel stream, grip first (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Dash combo: flat cross, rising cross, prime drawn back, dash cleave
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; cross, cross, 0.7 s charge (14 ticks) with the sword primed 20 deg above pointing at the mob, drawn back at the shoulder, then a ~12-block dash into an overhead cleave; camera travels with you; hit tick 36; swing 45 ticks, played once; charge before the swing (ticks 17-31); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact; forms: pixels spiral up the forearm (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Dash combo: rising cross, falling cross, prime low, dash sweep
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; cross, cross, 0.7 s charge (14 ticks) with the sword primed low at the hip, point 20 deg above the mob, then a ~12-block dash into a passing sweep; camera travels with you; hit tick 37; swing 45 ticks, played once; charge before the swing (ticks 18-32); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact; forms: pixel jet, tip first (ticks 0-14)

passes.title: Pickaxe rework: 3D pick, block breaking, running crater swing
passes.desc: J's note on 844 P1a: a more 3D but thin and dense pick, new block destruction with physical drops, light particles, new arm animations, and running through with the pick breaking about 8 blocks a swing in a small dome crater, not instantly. Three new pick designs mining a block each (P1a1-3), and three running-through takes (R1-3).

takes.name: Faceted crescent pick: three quick taps, the third breaks
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; faceted crescent pick; pixel stream build (frames 1-15); hits at frames 19, 23, 28, 44, 48, 53; blocks break at frames 30, 55 into 6 physical chunks each

takes.name: Laminated pick: forehand, backhand, the cracks creep between
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; laminated pick; pixel stream build (frames 1-15); hits at frames 21, 29, 47, 55; blocks break at frames 32, 58 into 6 physical chunks each

takes.name: Shell-and-core pick: heavy strike, crack spreads, pry bursts it
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; shell-and-core pick; pixel stream build (frames 1-15); hits at frames 25, 52; blocks break at frames 31, 58 into 6 physical chunks each

takes.name: Running chops: overhead every 9 ticks, 8-block dome craters
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; faceted crescent pick; runs in, 7 swings every 9 ticks, hits at frames 19, 28, 37, 46, 55, 64, 73; each swing cracks 8 blocks (56 in all), 5 ticks of cracking before they break into 4 physical chunks each

takes.name: Running figure-eight: alternating diagonals every 7 ticks
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; laminated pick; runs in, 9 swings every 7 ticks, hits at frames 18, 25, 32, 39, 46, 53, 60, 67, 74; each swing cracks 8 blocks (72 in all), 4 ticks of cracking before they break into 4 physical chunks each

takes.name: Running dome arcs: high right over to low left every 10 ticks
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; shell-and-core pick; runs in, 6 swings every 10 ticks, hits at frames 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70; each swing cracks 8 blocks (48 in all), 6 ticks of cracking before they break into 4 physical chunks each

passes.title: Enemies: scarier E1 round
passes.desc: Nine new fear creatures, three each for 845 E1a Veil Wisp (a light behind the veil that brightens with the reveal), E1b Mask Swarm (new, scarier designs) and E1c Stilt Stalker (scarier, more complex, real movement across the bay), all IMPROVE with notes.

takes.name: Curtain Veil
takes.facts: 16 long veil strips on a rail round a caged heart-light; the strips slide apart like a drawn curtain, front first, the light dim behind them brightening as the gap widens and flaring as the front clears; the heart swings out on its chain, the player shields his eyes; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Bell Veil
takes.facts: seven square cloth bands under a wide brim, three lights in a column inside; the bands telescope up bottom first and each light comes on as its band lifts; long folded arms unfold and reach as it glides in; the player freezes and shivers; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Scale Cocoon
takes.facts: five rings of overlapping scales round one eye; ring by ring, top to bottom, the scales snap open and the light steps up with each; the eye snaps round and a hard gaze lifts the player off his feet; scales flutter down at death; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Mask Totem
takes.facts: seven long bone masks stacked on a thin spine, 3 m tall, facing away and creaking round one by one; all snap to the player at once and the spine whips over so the top mask hangs in his face; he falls back; lit from below; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Stalk Crowd
takes.facts: nine masks on thin stalks rising from a black puddle, facing every way; the puddle slides under the player, the masks snap to him, the stalks stretch to ring his head and the jaws drop open, chattering over a glowing mouth; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Mosaic Face
takes.facts: one giant blank face 2.5 m tall built from small tiles with two deep eye-lights; its head jerks sideways, the tiles flip from the middle out, each a small face, then burst into a turning cage of faces round the player's head; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Creeping Stalker
takes.facts: very long stilt legs, knees far above its back, telescoping neck, caged head with a searchlight and fanged jaw; stalks in across the bay step-step-freeze (planted feet), head snapping sideways at each stop; rears, slams its front legs down either side of the player and drives its head into his face; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Skitter Stalker
takes.facts: flat body slung low between six stilt legs, one eye-light, mandibles, feelers; crosses the bay in sudden sideways bursts, dead still between them, always facing the player; coils, pounces and lands astride him, legs caging him in; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

takes.name: Unfolding Crawler
takes.facts: drags itself in low in lurches, folded legs peaking like tent poles; at the player it unfolds in six ticks to 3 m tall and hangs its head upside down in front of his face on a long neck, twitching; idle/approach 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a green construct shot (the light gutters out)

passes.title: Suits: C8b purples, circuit blues, hex plate variations
passes.desc: C8b's carbon weave (kept) in three other purples, with C8b as before for comparison; T1 circuit rebuilt with darker plates and brighter traces in three blue pairs; three new hex-plate builds of T2. Same C8b shape and suit-up; the reveal light is each take's corps colour on every piece.

takes.name: C8b (as before)
takes.facts: Violet carbon weave, unchanged; reference for the purples

takes.name: C8b in royal purple
takes.facts: Carbon weave recipe unchanged; royal purple (0.2, 0, 1.0): bluer and deeper than C8b's violet; reveal band, seams and ring royal purple

takes.name: C8b in deep plum
takes.facts: Carbon weave recipe unchanged; deep plum (0.15, 0, 0.42): the darkest purple, dim plates, dim seams

takes.name: C8b in ultraviolet
takes.facts: Carbon weave recipe unchanged; ultraviolet (0.06, 0, 1.0): blue-violet edge of purple

takes.name: Circuit: navy + electric blue
takes.facts: Near-black navy plate; bright electric-blue traces on an offset grid with square pads

takes.name: Circuit: steel black + cobalt
takes.facts: Blue-black steel plate; deep cobalt traces in two crossed grids (dense maze), no pads

takes.name: Circuit: indigo + azure
takes.facts: Indigo-black plate; sparse azure traces with big ringed pads

takes.name: Hex: fine honeycomb
takes.facts: Red; true hexagons 3 px wide, nearly flat, every gap glows steadily

takes.name: Hex: big domed tiles
takes.facts: Red; 8 px hex tiles domed in deep relief, dark gaps, a lit hex outline inset in each tile

takes.name: Hex: twinkling cells
takes.facts: Red; 5 px bevelled hex cells, faint gaps, random cells light up and fade on a 3 s cycle

passes.title: BRD bricks and X5E ripples (3 each)
passes.desc: J's 701 re-rating (18:47): BRD 'more detail on the bricks, or make them one of our new metallic materials (not the glowing lines)'; X5E 'ripples more efficiently packed onto big texture surfaces'. Same 8 s close tour (wall, dome, particles, suit).

takes.name: BRD neon bricks - carved
takes.facts: bevelled edges lit from the top left, stone grain, hairline cracks, chipped corners, pits; glowing mortar and rising sparks as BRD; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: BRD neon bricks - brushed alloy
takes.facts: bricks are brushed metal (pass 603's pinstripe alloy) with the carving as relief; only the mortar and sparks glow; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: BRD neon bricks - dark gunmetal
takes.facts: bricks are dark hammered metal (pass 603's hex plate metal) with the carving as relief; only the mortar and sparks glow; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: X5P packed ripple emerald - ripple grid
takes.facts: one ripple source per block (16 per 4x4 tile instead of 1), neighbours out of step so the rings interlock; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: X5P packed ripple emerald - interference
takes.facts: seven sources per tile whose waves add up: a moving lattice of crossings over the whole surface, no dark gaps; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: X5P packed ripple emerald - ripple rain
takes.facts: 46 small ripples spawning all over the surface at different times, like rain on water; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

passes.title: Bows and shields: round 3 variations
passes.desc: Three new builds each of 842's B1a, B3a, B3b, B3c, H2a, H2c and H3b (J rated them IMPROVE with no note); each keeps its parent's idea and is built a different way. Hand-held shields are held from behind on grip bars and never touch the arms.

takes.name: swept riser: reflex + Warren truss
takes.facts: swept bar bent reflex over a zigzag Warren-truss spine; oval ports light at full draw; solid limbs, hybrid cams; single-pin scope; 3-vane lighted nock

takes.name: swept riser: round tube, twin spines
takes.facts: swept bar as a round tube with glowing collar ports, twin spines either side; split limbs, binary cams roll 220; 5-pin; long rod + 2 back bars

takes.name: swept riser: blade + ladder, ports count
takes.facts: swept deep blade with a ladder truss to an arc spine; 8 ports light one by one on the draw; single cam + idler; 3-pin

takes.name: W1 plate: slots, rear-deploy heads
takes.facts: W1 plate with long rimmed slots; single cam; 3-pin; hip quiver; 3-blade rear-deploying heads swing back in the foam

takes.name: W1 plate: split plates, claw heads
takes.facts: two thin W1 plates with a gap held by glowing spacer bolts, slide together as it forms; binary cams; 5-pin; long 2-blade claw heads open forward

takes.name: W1 plate: big windows, spinning heads
takes.facts: W1 plate with two big glowing-rimmed windows; 7 pins in one column; 5-arrow quiver; 4-blade heads spin as they open

takes.name: truss: space frame, scanning laser
takes.facts: 3D space-frame carbon riser (two chords each side, cross tubes); laser scans the target 11-17 and counts 6, 12, 18; slider pin drops; 3-blade heads

takes.name: truss: bowstring truss, laser pulses
takes.facts: bowstring-truss riser (curved front chord, straight back chord); rangefinder on the end of the front rod fires 3 pulses 12-17, reads 18; solid limbs, binary; 2-blade

takes.name: truss: K-truss, ring ranges
takes.facts: K-truss riser with hex-nut nodes; the ring arm leads and points at the target 8-15, a laser from the ring reads 18; slider pin drops; then the draw

takes.name: cube riser: twisted helix, two shots
takes.facts: half-pixel cubes in a twisted double helix; release 25; a twist wave rolls through the cubes 26-31 as the 2nd arrow comes from the quiver; release 43

takes.name: cube riser: outline, arrow from ring
takes.facts: cubes trace only the riser outline (solid at the grip); no quiver: the 2nd arrow is built at the hand from ring cubes 27-32; release 25 and 45

takes.name: cube riser: checker, three shots
takes.facts: dense checker of small cubes 2 wide x 3 deep; three fast shots from the 6-arrow quiver, release 23, 38, 53; 2-blade heads

takes.name: curved brick: arch top, laid brick by brick
takes.facts: curved BR1 tower 1.0 x 1.9 with a round arch top and keystone; each brick flies in from the ring 5-13; held from behind on two grip bars; hit knocks near bricks back, they settle

takes.name: curved brick: barrel stack bond, mortar flash
takes.facts: BR1 bricks in stack bond on a barrel surface (curved both ways), rim frame; columns rise from the ground 5-13; hit flashes the bricks outward from the impact
takes.fpNote: No 1st-person clip: the arms are in view in 0% of frames from the eyes

takes.fpNote: No 1st-person clip: the arms are in view in 0% of frames from the eyes

takes.facts: header bar over the grips, 9 thin hinged H1 slats unroll down into the heater outline 6-18; hit swings the hinged slats back in a ripple down the chain

takes.facts: push; ground line 1.6 ahead; 9 curved ribs lying flat swing up on hinges at the line (6-15) arching over like a quarter dome, H1 panels fill; hit bends the struck ribs

takes.name: planted wall: hex columns
takes.facts: push; a curved band of 29 H1 hex columns extrudes up from the ground line 1.6 ahead (6-14), leaning in like a dome; hit sinks the struck columns, they pop back

takes.name: planted wall: sliding screens
takes.facts: push; a post plants 1.6 ahead (5-8), three curved H1 screens slide out of it sideways (8-16), leaning in like a dome; hit shoves the screens, dent ring

passes.title: Mech suits: MCb and MCc variations
passes.desc: Three new builds each for 843 MCb Rocket Juggernaut and MCc Breaker (IMPROVE, no note): MCb keeps R1 cells, rockets and a villager pilot; MCc keeps H1 hex, horns, a zombie pilot and a two-handed hammer that lands face first. Each is built, formed and moves its own way.

takes.facts: R1 cells, no legs: round hover skirt with flaps, ram plow, two shoulder rocket pods; unpacks out of a construct cube; S-curve glide banking into turns; four-rocket salvo arcing onto the ground; pack-boosted ram charge plow first; villager pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Orbit Juggernaut
takes.facts: R1 cells, heavy body with floating limbs (orbiting cells for upper arms), halo collar, cross-pattern 4-nozzle pack; spirals in from a vortex; stomping walk; drill fist corkscrews 4 m out on a chain of cells; meteor fists blast up and dive onto the ground; villager pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Anvil Breaker

takes.name: Ram Breaker
takes.facts: H1 hex, tall and lean, curled ram horns, hex scale skirt, long spiked maul carried on the shoulder; rises up out of the floor; stalking walk; overhead from the shoulder, face first; throws the maul end over end, lands face first 4 m ahead, called back to the hand; zombie pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Earthshaker
takes.facts: H1 hex, widest, crown of horns, hanging hex chains, huge two-faced block hammer; gathers from scattered shards (shatter in reverse); charging run hammer low; double tap face first; one-knee slam and a fissure of hex pillars bursting up in a line; zombie pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

passes.title: Flying mounts: round 3 variations
passes.desc: Three new variations each of 841's winged horse (F1a), comet horse (F1c), blocky glider (F2c) and the three real-size ghast constructs (F3a shell, F3b cage, F3c strata), same textures, each built and flown a different way.

takes.name: winged horse: fan wings, R2 K1
takes.facts: nine slats fan open on one hub; crouch and spring take-off on one big stroke, then a climbing circle to 9 blocks

takes.name: winged horse: four wings, R2 K1
takes.facts: fore and hind feather wings beat out of phase, fast; never stops galloping, runs up the air in three surges to 7.8

takes.name: winged horse: Z-fold wings, R2 K1
takes.facts: three-joint wings with covert, secondary and primary feathers unfold from a Z; one huge stroke at 48-60, then soars an S-turn with two trim flaps

takes.name: comet horse: comet tail, H1
takes.facts: one lathe body running into a 1.6-block ringed comet tail, hind legs fold into it; climbs to 7, a barrel roll at 66-86, flakes stream from the tail tip

takes.name: comet horse: ring slices, H1
takes.facts: body built of eleven separate slices with sky between; a few strides, then a helix climb 1.5 turns to 10 blocks; light ribbons from the hooves

takes.name: comet horse: one-piece hull, H1
takes.facts: single smooth hull to a pointed rear, neck fins; three bounding leaps with hex shock rings, then a dive and climb out; hex-plate flakes

takes.name: blocky glider: voxel-grid wings, H1
takes.facts: each wing a 6 x 3 grid of loose cubes on six span joints, the flap runs out as a wave; runs on all fours, launches, circles a thermal up to 8

takes.name: blocky glider: folding panels, H1
takes.facts: five hinged H1 panels per wing, zigzag-packed, snap flat; a construct pillar lifts it 4.5, it dives off, pulls into a glide, the pillar breaks

takes.name: blocky glider: stepped delta, H1
takes.facts: rigid stepped pixel-art delta wings and a tail fin; hovers up 3 on quick beats, darts forward, a 70-degree wingover turn

takes.name: ghast shell: rounded cube, R2 K1
takes.facts: one smooth rounded-cube shell 0.26 off the skin, cone sleeves; breathes 3%, rises 3, glides out with a sway

takes.name: ghast shell: banded double shell, R2 K1
takes.facts: thin snug inner shell plus five barrel bands, three bands per sleeve; lifts to 6, turns in two clean 30-degree steps

takes.name: ghast shell: chamfered, R2 K1
takes.facts: one chamfered gem-cut shell, quarter-twisted square sleeves, rider rail; strafes 4 sideways while rising, swings round and climbs

takes.name: ghast cage: round rods, W1
